// Halton low-discrepancy scattering through a volume: Count quasi-random
// points from radical inverses in bases BaseX, BaseY and BaseZ, which must be
// pairwise coprime (typically 2, 3 and 5)
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Halton_sequence).
type HaltonPattern3D
    implements IValue
{
    Region: Bounds3D;
    Count: Integer;
    BaseX: Integer;
    BaseY: Integer;
    BaseZ: Integer;
}
